mothScreenArrest.text: mothScreen_555~m0th was arrested in his pajamas. He told the police someone had been watching him through his own computer. Nobody believed him. Byte went to live with his mom.

mothScreenTurnIn.text: mothScreen_556~Elias Krumm walked into a police station and told them everything: Crow, the address, the Club. They wrote down the first two.

mothScreenDoor.text: mothScreen_557~A boy in a helmet came to your door and left. You never saw m0th online again. Sometimes, at night, you still check your webcam light.

mothScreenNoDoor.text: mothScreen_558~You never opened the door. m0th never came back online. But someone, somewhere, knows your building.

mothScreenMember.text: mothScreen_559~m0th became a member of the Primate Observation Club. Somewhere, a new camera light blinks.

mothScreenNora.text: mothScreen_560~Nora Vance moved in with her sister and changed every password. She never found out who called her that night.

mothScreenNoraFled.text: mothScreen_701~Nora Vance jumped out of her kitchen window in her socks. She never went back to Kestrel Lane, and she still checks every car that slows down.

mothScreenNoraSpared.text: mothScreen_702~The police stopped Dorian Pell one street before Kestrel Lane. Nora Vance never knew how close he came.

mothScreenDorianFree.text: mothScreen_703~Nobody reported Dorian Pell. He is still out there, and he has learned to pay better hackers.

mothScreenDorian.text: mothScreen_561~Dorian Pell went back to jail. In his cell he keeps asking who reported him. Nobody tells him.
